targets.name: Ball Control
targets.summary: 86 is the researched target for a 135° outside-foot first touch. This first-touch unlock is card-gated; boosters and form do not count.

nextThresholds.effect: Running trap behind you / outside foot
High ball taken at the side

targets.source: Supplied research · Ball Control / Dribbling / Tight Possession

targets.name: Dribbling
targets.summary: 90 is a practical target; consider 91 if you rely on fake shots or Acceleration Burst. The card-only outside-foot touch gate is 80.

nextThresholds.effect: Three outside-foot first touches (card value only)

targets.source: Supplied research · Ball Control / Dribbling / Tight Possession

targets.name: Tight Possession
targets.summary: The supplied notes say nothing unlocks at a specific value. Gains are larger below 90; 90 to 99 saves only about 5 ms between touches.

nextThresholds.effect: Practical target; diminishing returns above this

targets.source: Supplied research · Ball Control / Dribbling / Tight Possession

targets.name: Balance
targets.summary: The supplied notes place a recovery-frame step at 89. Dribbling + Balance must total 150 to react to a challenge from behind.
targets.source: Supplied research · Balance / Speed / Acceleration / Physical Contact / Stamina

targets.name: Speed
targets.summary: The notes describe stronger per-point gains from 60 to 90 than above 90. With the ball, top speed also depends on Dribbling.

nextThresholds.effect: Practical target; smaller gains above this

targets.source: Supplied research · Balance / Speed / Acceleration / Physical Contact / Stamina

targets.name: Acceleration
targets.summary: The supplied notes identify 89 → 90 as the last full-value point; points above 90 still help at a lower rate.

nextThresholds.effect: Last full-value point before the final step

targets.source: Supplied research · Balance / Speed / Acceleration / Physical Contact / Stamina

targets.name: Physical Contact
targets.summary: The research frames this as a gap against the opponent: being 11 or more below the charger causes a heavy stumble in the described interaction.
targets.source: Supplied research · Balance / Speed / Acceleration / Physical Contact / Stamina

targets.name: Stamina
targets.summary: The notes describe tank size, not drain rate. Each point from 90 to 99 adds more tank than a point in the 80s.

nextThresholds.effect: Practical target; larger per-point gains from 90 onward

targets.name: Dribbling + Balance
targets.summary: The supplied notes claim this combined gate is needed to react to a slide tackle / challenge from behind.

skills.name: Momentum Dribbling
skills.effect: Dribbling, Tight Possession, Speed, and Acceleration +6 while carrying the ball 18 m or more past halfway.

skills.name: Magnetic Feet
skills.effect: Dribbling, Tight Possession, Physical Contact, and Balance +2 per nearby opponent, up to +8 while carrying the ball.

skills.name: Super-sub
skills.effect: +1 to every stat except Stamina when the player comes on at half-time or later.

skills.name: Through Passing
skills.effect: +5 pass stat for the through ball itself; this is not a permanent card-stat change.

skills.name: Visionary Pass
skills.effect: The receiver gets +6 on their next first-time action, according to the supplied notes.

skills.name: Interception
skills.effect: The supplied notes report faster reactions to passes aimed at the marked player and +5 Defensive Engagement when reading passes.
